# Accessibility Features on Facebook

Facebook offers accessibility tools for users with disabilities. Enable screen readers, keyboard navigation, and captioning.

## Tools
- **Screen Reader**: Compatible with assistive tech
- **Keyboard Shortcuts**: Navigate without mouse
- **Captions**: Auto-generated for videos

Explore Settings > Accessibility to customize features.

# Advertising on Facebook

Run ads on Facebook to reach target audiences. Use the Ads Manager to create campaigns, set budgets, and track results.

## Ad Types
- **Image/Video Ads**: Visual content
- **Carousel Ads**: Multiple images
- **Lead Ads**: Collect contact info

Target demographics, interests, and behaviors for effective advertising.

# Creating a Facebook Account

To create a Facebook account, go to facebook.com and click "Create New Account." Enter your name, email or phone number, password, and date of birth. Verify your account via email or SMS, and you're ready to start connecting.

## Steps
1. Visit facebook.com
2. Fill in the registration form
3. Verify your email or phone
4. Set up your profile

Remember to use a strong password and enable two-factor authentication for security.

# Facebook Dating

Facebook Dating helps you find meaningful relationships. Create a dating profile separate from your main account and match with potential partners.

## Features
- **Profile**: Add photos and prompts
- **Matching**: Like or pass on profiles
- **Events**: Join dating events

Respect others and report inappropriate behavior.

# Events and Invitations on Facebook

Create and manage events on Facebook. Invite friends, set details like date, time, and location. RSVP to events you're invited to.

## Event Management
- **Create Event**: Choose public or private
- **Invite Guests**: Send invites via Facebook
- **RSVP**: Respond to invitations

Use events to organize gatherings and stay connected.

# Friend Requests and Connections

Friend requests allow you to connect with others. Accept or decline requests from the notifications. You can also send requests by searching for people.

## Managing Friends
- **Accept Requests**: Click "Confirm" to add friends
- **Decline**: Ignore or delete requests
- **Unfriend**: Remove connections if needed

Build meaningful connections while maintaining your comfort level.

# Getting Started with Facebook

Facebook is a social networking platform that allows users to connect with friends, family, and communities worldwide. To get started, create an account, verify your email, and begin exploring the News Feed, where you can see updates from your connections.

## Key Features
- **News Feed**: View posts from friends and pages you follow.
- **Profile**: Customize your personal page with photos, bio, and interests.
- **Friends**: Send friend requests and build your network.

For more details, visit the Facebook Help Center.

# Groups and Communities on Facebook

Groups are spaces for discussions and shared interests. Join existing groups or create your own. Participate by posting, commenting, and engaging with members.

## Group Types
- **Public**: Anyone can join and see posts
- **Private**: Invitation-only, posts visible to members
- **Secret**: Hidden from search, invite-only

Use groups to connect with like-minded people and communities.

# Facebook Live

Go live on Facebook to broadcast videos in real-time. Interact with viewers through comments and reactions. Access via the "Live" button on your profile or pages.

## Going Live
- **Prepare**: Ensure good lighting and audio
- **Broadcast**: Start streaming and engage viewers
- **End**: Stop when done and save the video

Use Live for announcements, Q&A, or entertainment.

# Facebook Marketplace

Marketplace is a platform to buy and sell items locally. Browse listings, post items for sale, and communicate with buyers/sellers.

## Using Marketplace
- **Browse**: Search for items by category
- **Sell**: Post photos, descriptions, and prices
- **Buy**: Message sellers and arrange pickups

Follow safety tips when meeting for transactions.

# Facebook Messenger

Messenger is Facebook's messaging app for chatting with friends. Send texts, photos, videos, and make voice/video calls. Access it via the app or website.

## Features
- **Chats**: One-on-one or group conversations
- **Calls**: Voice and video options
- **Reactions**: Respond with emojis

Keep conversations private and respectful.

# Navigating the Facebook Interface

The Facebook interface includes the News Feed on the home page, a sidebar for navigation, and a top bar for search and notifications. Use the menu to access features like Groups, Marketplace, and Events.

## Main Sections
- **Home**: News Feed and stories
- **Profile**: Your personal page
- **Friends**: Manage connections
- **Groups**: Join communities

Explore the interface to familiarize yourself with all features.

# Notifications on Facebook

Manage notifications to stay updated. Customize what you receive via Settings > Notifications. Choose email, push, or in-app alerts.

## Types
- **Posts**: From friends and pages
- **Messages**: New chats
- **Events**: Invitations and updates

Adjust settings to avoid overload while staying informed.

# Facebook Pages and Business Accounts

Pages allow businesses and organizations to connect with audiences. Create a page, post updates, and engage with followers.

## Managing Pages
- **Create Page**: Choose category and details
- **Post Content**: Share updates and promotions
- **Insights**: Analyze performance metrics

Use pages to build brand presence and community.

# Posting on Facebook

Posting on Facebook allows you to share updates, photos, and videos with your friends. Click "What's on your mind?" to create a post, add media, and tag friends or locations.

## Types of Posts
- **Text Posts**: Share thoughts or news
- **Photos/Videos**: Upload media from your device
- **Live Videos**: Go live to interact in real-time

Always consider your audience's privacy settings before posting.

# Privacy Settings on Facebook

Privacy settings control who sees your posts and information. Access them via Settings > Privacy. You can set audience for posts, limit past posts, and manage who can contact you.

## Key Options
- **Post Audience**: Public, Friends, Only Me
- **Profile Visibility**: Control who sees your profile info
- **Blocking**: Block unwanted users

Regularly review and update your privacy settings to protect your data.

# Customizing Your Profile

Personalize your profile with photos, cover images, bio, and sections like work, education, and interests. Edit via your profile page.

## Profile Elements
- **Profile Picture**: Main photo
- **Cover Photo**: Banner image
- **About**: Bio and details
- **Timeline**: Posts and life events

Make your profile reflect your personality and interests.

# Reporting and Blocking on Facebook

Report abusive content or users via the report button. Block users to prevent contact and hide their posts.

## Reporting
- **Content**: Report posts, comments, or profiles
- **Users**: Flag harassment or spam
- **Blocking**: Prevent interactions

Help keep Facebook a positive environment.

# Security and Safety on Facebook

Protect your account with strong passwords, two-factor authentication, and regular security checks. Report suspicious activity and use privacy tools.

## Security Tips
- **Password**: Use unique, strong passwords
- **2FA**: Enable two-factor authentication
- **Login Alerts**: Monitor account access

Stay safe by being cautious with personal information.

# Facebook Stories

Stories are temporary posts that disappear after 24 hours. Share photos, videos, and updates that appear at the top of the News Feed.

## Creating Stories
- **Add Media**: Upload or take photos/videos
- **Customize**: Add text, stickers, and effects
- **Share**: Post to your story or send privately

Stories are great for casual, ephemeral sharing.
